# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 5 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 4 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 102 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 26 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 4 tokens; Font size — 22 tokens; Line height — 26 tokens; Letter spacing — 7 tokens; Density — 14 tokens; Icon size — 4 tokens; Border width — 2 tokens; Opacity — 2 tokens; Layout — 22 tokens; Z index — 14 tokens; Motion — 8 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ground);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the grimoire value */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | grimoire | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ground` | #101014 | Tier 2 · role. Level 0: the page ground behind everything, the shell's base colour, the Page and the docked Chronicle. The stage paints a vignette of ground-deep over it. |
| `ground-deep` | #0b0b0f | Tier 2 · role. Below Level 0: wells (inputs, item slots, the inventory grid's gutters), the stage's vignette edges and the letterbox behind stage art. |
| `surface` | #101014b8 | Tier 2 · role. Level 1: the NavRail, Panels, lists and the JourneyCard. Translucent over the frame's backdrop, never blurred (D-102); where content passes beneath, use surface-solid. |
| `surface-solid` | #16161b | Tier 2 · role. Level 1 where something passes beneath it: sticky table headers and columns, the floating Chronicle drawer and lg-level-1--float. The opaque form of surface, about what surface shows over the frame's backdrop (D-102). |
| `surface-raised` | #22222a | Tier 2 · role. Level 2, one step above surface: hover, selected and pinned washes; popovers, tooltips, hover cards, menus and toasts. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-level-numeral);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). The files are in `fonts/`, beside `tokens.css`, which declares them with `@font-face`.

| family | file | CSS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Atkinson Hyperlegible | `fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegible-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `var(--font-readable)` |

Every face: `fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegible-Regular.woff2` (Atkinson Hyperlegible, 400), `fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegible-Italic.woff2` (Atkinson Hyperlegible, 400, italic), `fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegible-Bold.woff2` (Atkinson Hyperlegible, 700), `fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegible-BoldItalic.woff2` (Atkinson Hyperlegible, 700, italic).

## Spacing

Two tiers, in rem so spacing scales with text. The 4px scale (space-*) holds every raw step. Semantic tokens name the job: inset (padding inside a container), stack (vertical gap), inline (horizontal gap) and section (between groups); each equals one scale step and the stylesheet aliases it to that step. Change a scale step, not an alias (Foundations · Space & Density).

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (26)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 0.25rem | Icon-to-label gap, keycap padding. (4px at the default text size.) |
| `space-2` | 0.5rem | Inside tags and small controls; gap between stat tiles. (8px at the default text size.) |
| `space-3` | 0.75rem | Between related rows; tile padding. (12px at the default text size.) |
| `space-4` | 1rem | Panel padding on small screens; rail item padding. (16px at the default text size.) |
| `space-5` | 1.25rem | Top bar horizontal padding. (20px at the default text size.) |
| `space-6` | 1.5rem | Folio and panel padding; gap between sections. (24px at the default text size.) |
| `space-8` | 2rem | Between major blocks in the Folio. (32px at the default text size.) |
| `space-10` | 2.5rem | Stage inset from the rail and folio. (40px at the default text size.) |
| `space-12` | 3rem | Rail top padding; space above screen titles. (48px at the default text size.) |
| `space-16` | 4rem | Stage breathing room around a Constellation. (64px at the default text size.) |
| `inset-xs` | 0.25rem | Inset · padding inside the smallest parts: key caps, badges, counts. Aliases space-1. (4px at the default text size.) |
| `inset-sm` | 0.5rem | Inset · tags and small controls; a Compact cell’s horizontal padding; the inner surface in a Compact region. Aliases space-2. (8px at the default text size.) |
| `inset-md` | 0.75rem | Inset · tiles and inner surfaces in a Standard region (StatTile, LoadoutSlot); a Standard cell’s horizontal padding; a Compact container. Aliases space-3. (12px at the default text size.) |
| `inset-lg` | 1rem | Inset · a Standard container: Panel body and head; a Comfortable cell’s horizontal padding; the inner surface in a Comfortable region. Aliases space-4. (16px at the default text size.) |
| `inset-xl` | 1.5rem | Inset · a Comfortable container: dialogs and identity blocks. Aliases space-6. (24px at the default text size.) |
| `stack-xs` | 0.25rem | Stack · label to value, eyebrow to title; a Compact cell’s vertical padding. Aliases space-1. (4px at the default text size.) |
| `stack-sm` | 0.5rem | Stack · rows of one group; a Standard cell’s vertical padding; the gap between elements in a Compact region. Aliases space-2. (8px at the default text size.) |
| `stack-md` | 0.75rem | Stack · related blocks in a Panel; a Comfortable cell’s vertical padding; the gap in a Standard region. Aliases space-3. (12px at the default text size.) |
| `stack-lg` | 1rem | Stack · groups inside a container; the gap in a Comfortable region. Aliases space-4. (16px at the default text size.) |
| `inline-xs` | 0.25rem | Inline · icon to label, value to unit. Aliases space-1. (4px at the default text size.) |
| `inline-sm` | 0.5rem | Inline · tags in a row, a Button’s icon and label; the gap between a row’s parts in a Compact region. Aliases space-2. (8px at the default text size.) |
| `inline-md` | 0.75rem | Inline · controls in a toolbar; the gap between a row’s parts in a Standard region. Aliases space-3. (12px at the default text size.) |
| `inline-lg` | 1rem | Inline · control groups; the gap between a row’s parts in a Comfortable region. Aliases space-4. (16px at the default text size.) |
| `section-sm` | 1.5rem | Section · between Panels on a Page (stack-lg in the game's frame, D-120), between blocks in the Folio. Aliases space-6. (24px at the default text size.) |
| `section-md` | 2rem | Section · the Page’s side padding; between major regions of a screen. Aliases space-8. (32px at the default text size.) |
| `section-lg` | 3rem | Section · above a screen title; the rail’s top padding. Aliases space-12. (48px at the default text size.) |

## Radius

By role, not by size (Foundations · Shape). Regions are square; containers take 2px, controls, tags and slots 4px, popovers and drawers 8px; the one circle is the Presence dot. No pill: nothing takes a full radius.

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-container) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-container` | 2px | Containers and rows: Panels, dialog sheets and confirmations, the band SectionRule, and row washes (Ledger rows, rail items, EntryList entries, chat lines, suggestions). Regions — the Folio, Banner, Stage, rail and Page — are square. |
| `radius-control` | 4px | Controls, tags and slots: Buttons, inputs, tabs, key caps and clickable CurrencyPills; Tags, count badges and rarity codes; ItemSlots, thumbnails, LoadoutSlots and StatTiles. Focus rings on links and icon buttons follow it. |
| `radius-float` | 8px | Popovers and drawers: tooltips, hover cards, menus, suggestion lists, toasts and the floating chat drawer. Only what floats. |
| `radius-circle` | 50% | The Presence dot, and nothing else: the circle means presence (Foundations · Shape). Never a count badge, an icon button, a bullet or a portrait. |

## Shadow

Surfaces are lit like candlelight with soft, dark shadows; nothing glows. The focus ring is a ground-coloured gap plus a solid 2px ring.

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-panel) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-panel` | 0 24px 48px -16px #000000d9, 0 0 0 1px #00000080 | Level 3: the Folio, dialog sheets, confirmations, the tour's coach mark and the rail drawer. |
| `shadow-float` | 0 12px 28px -8px #000000cc | Floating Levels 1 and 2: the Chronicle drawer, popovers, tooltips, hover cards, menus and toasts. |
| `shadow-text-art` | 0 1px 14px #0b0b0f, 0 0 3px #0b0b0f | text-shadow for any label set over Stage art (Sigil labels, stage captions). |
| `focus-ring` | 0 0 0 2px #101014, 0 0 0 4px #f5d48f | Keyboard focus on every interactive element (box-shadow, so it follows the radius). |

/* var(--text-level-numeral) */

## Density

Density modes: Comfortable (identity and detail views, the Folio, dialogs), Standard (the default, for panels and forms) and Compact (tables, inventory, rankings, guild members, combat logs, order books). data-density on a container sets the mode inside it; paddings and gaps come from the semantic spacing tokens. Values are rem.

### Use

```css
/* var(--row-comfortable) */
```

### Tokens (14)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `row-comfortable` | 3rem | Comfortable · Minimum height of a one-line row in a list, a Ledger or a table: 48px at the default text size. |
| `row-standard` | 2.5rem | Standard · Minimum height of a one-line row in a list, a Ledger or a table: 40px at the default text size. |
| `row-compact` | 2rem | Compact · Minimum height of a one-line row in a list, a Ledger or a table: 32px at the default text size. |
| `control-comfortable` | 2.75rem | Comfortable · Height of a Button, an input and a primary tab: 44px at the default text size. |
| `control-standard` | 2.5rem | Standard · Height of a Button, an input and a primary tab: 40px at the default text size. |
| `control-compact` | 2rem | Compact · Height of a Button, an input and a primary tab: 32px at the default text size. |
| `icon-comfortable` | 1.25rem | Comfortable · Icon size in rows and controls: 20px at the default text size (icon-md). |
| `icon-standard` | 1.25rem | Standard · Icon size in rows and controls: 20px at the default text size, the same as Comfortable (icon-md). It was 18px, off the icon scale. |
| `icon-compact` | 1rem | Compact · Icon size in rows and controls: 16px at the default text size (icon-sm). |
| `thumb-comfortable` | 2.5rem | Comfortable · The framed thumbnail at the start of a list row (an item, an Essence, a player): 40px at the default text size. |
| `thumb-standard` | 2rem | Standard · The framed thumbnail at the start of a list row (an item, an Essence, a player): 32px at the default text size. |
| `thumb-compact` | 1.5rem | Compact · The framed thumbnail at the start of a list row (an item, an Essence, a player): 24px at the default text size. |
| `target-min` | 1.5rem | Accessibility · the smallest target for anything a player clicks or taps: 24 × 24px at the default size (WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8). Inline links in text are exempt. |
| `target-primary` | 2rem | Accessibility · the recommended target for primary actions: 32 × 32px at the default size, the Compact control height. |

## Icon size

The icon size scale (Foundations · Iconography). Line icons are drawn on a 24-unit grid at 1.6 stroke and shown at 16, 20 or 24px; 12px is for inline markers only, drawn solid for it. In rem, so icons grow with the reading-size setting.

### Use

```css
/* var(--icon-marker) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon-marker` | 0.75rem | 12px · inline markers only: a solid sign beside a name or on a slot's corner — the Nobility crown beside a body-size name, a locked or favourite marker. Never a line icon: at 12px its 1.6 stroke falls to 0.8px. |
| `icon-sm` | 1rem | 16px · inline with text and in Compact rows and controls: cost lists, Ledger and ListRow labels, sm Buttons, a condition's icon inside its Tag, the search field, the Chronicle's controls. The smallest size for a line icon. |
| `icon-md` | 1.25rem | 20px · the default: NavRail items, Standard and Comfortable rows and controls, the TopBar's menu. |
| `icon-lg` | 1.5rem | 24px · the drawing's own size, for display: the PageHeader's section mark, an empty ItemSlot's slot icon, a JourneyCard's unlock, a reveal's heading. |

## Border width

Two widths (Foundations · Lines). A line’s meaning comes from its colour and style; width only sets a selection apart from everything at rest. No other border width is drawn.

### Use

```css
/* var(--border-hairline) */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `border-hairline` | 1px | Every line at rest: separators, interactive edges, floating-surface edges, the gilt frames, dotted leaders and dashed empty or locked edges. |
| `border-emphasis` | 2px | Selection edges only: the selected row’s start bar, the selected slot ring, the active tab and channel bars, the current entry; and Track diamonds, drawn at a size they need. Never a resting edge, and not the focus ring (shadow focus-ring). |

## Opacity

Opacity for state (Standards · States · Channels). Opacity fades art only — never text, an edge that carries meaning, or the focus ring, so every word stays at its contrast. Motion fades are separate (Foundations · Motion).

### Use

```css
/* var(--opacity-unowned) */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opacity-unowned` | 0.4 | Not owned (Standards · States · Ownership and use): the art of a thing the player doesn't have, in a collection, codex or shop. Its name drops to ink-muted and says "Not owned"; the art alone never carries it. |
| `opacity-drag-origin` | 0.4 | Dragging (Standards · States · Interaction): the place a dragged thing left. It keeps its room, so nothing reflows, while the copy under the pointer lifts with shadow-float on z-drag. |

## Layout

Shell dimensions and content breakpoints in rem, so columns widen with the reading-size setting and everything reflows sooner (Foundations · Accessibility · Text scaling). Layouts answer to the width of their region, not the window: content-* are container breakpoints (Foundations · Layout).

```css
/* var(--rail-width) */
```

## Z index

The layer stack, bottom to top (Foundations · Surfaces & Layering). The game's four values are unchanged (overlay 50, popover 100, modal 200, detached popover 300); the rest fill the gaps around them. Every z-index reads one of these; a scrim sits one below the layer it serves, and art inside an isolated Stage or Banner may sit at −1 and −2.

### Use

```css
/* var(--z-content) */
```

### Tokens (14)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `z-content` | 0 | Layer 0 · content: the stage, the Page and everything in flow. The default; written only to reset a layer. |
| `z-raised` | 1 | A focused row, or the region the pointer or focus is in, rises above its neighbours inside its own stacking context. Never used across regions. |
| `z-sticky` | 10 | Sticky table headers, a table's held first column and sticky section heads, over the content that scrolls beneath them. |
| `z-chrome` | 20 | The shell's chrome over the stage: the TopBar and KeyHints, and the NavRail column. |
| `z-folio` | 30 | The Folio column, which lays its shadow over the stage, and the docked Chronicle beside or under it. |
| `z-chat-float` | 40 | The floating Chronicle drawer, which may be dragged over the Folio, and the Chronicle's bottom dock on small screens. |
| `z-overlay` | 50 | The rail drawer on small screens and its scrim (one below). The game's value. |
| `z-popover` | 100 | Popovers, tooltips, hover cards, menus and suggestion lists opened from the page. The game's value. |
| `z-modal` | 200 | A dialog and its scrim (one below). Only one at a time. The game's value. |
| `z-confirm` | 250 | A confirmation and its scrim, over the dialog that opened it. One at a time; it opens nothing else. |
| `z-popover-detached` | 300 | Popovers portaled to the body from inside a dialog or a confirmation, so they sit above it and are never clipped by it. The game's value. |
| `z-toast` | 400 | Toasts: brief outcomes, over every page layer and dialog. They never take focus. |
| `z-tour` | 500 | The guided tour (First Steps): its spotlight scrim and coach mark, over everything it may point at. |
| `z-drag` | 600 | A drag preview under the pointer, over everything, the tour included. |

## Motion

Durations and easings (Foundations · Motion). Quiet: nothing bounces, overshoots or loops — only an indeterminate progress indicator and live combat playback may — and only transform and opacity animate. Under reduced motion the tokens keep their values and every transition and animation ends at once.

### Use

```css
/* var(--duration-instant) */
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `duration-instant` | 0ms | No transition. A press going down, a selection or toggle landing, the current location moving, a drag following the pointer (the floating Chronicle), a drawer that collapses into its bar. And what every category becomes under reduced motion. |
| `duration-fast` | 140ms | Feedback and state: a hover wash fading in and out, a press releasing, a Sigil settling at its selected size, a tooltip or hover card, a live Meter following combat ticks, and anything leaving — a drawer closing, a popover going. |
| `duration-base` | 220ms | Spatial, arriving: the rail drawer sliding in and its scrim, the Chronicle's body rising in as it opens, a sheet, content a toggle opens. |
| `duration-slow` | 400ms | Value change: a Meter filling to a new step, a number counting to a value the player caused (after combat, after a purchase). Also the live mark fading out. |
| `duration-reveal` | 600ms | Reveal: a reward or result appearing — victory, loot, a craft, a level — once per result. Also how long the live mark holds before it fades. The longest duration: no transition runs longer. |
| `ease-standard` | cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) | Something changing where it stands: hover and press washes, a selection settling, a Meter's fill, a count, the live mark's fade. |
| `ease-enter` | cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) | Something arriving: a drawer sliding in, a popover, a reveal. Decelerates into place and never overshoots. |
| `ease-exit` | cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1) | Something leaving: a drawer closing, a popover fading out, always at duration-fast. Accelerates away. |
